For use by...
Submitted by X

Contents
A two-person work as shown in the attachment.
Hairstyle: long and shoulder-length short hair
They are smiling and talking in a happy atmosphere.
We would like to have two red roses and one blue rose somewhere in the picture.
We would like to have an image of a broken heart as shown in the attached picture, with each other's hands. (Sorry for the unclear picture...)

We would also like to leave other details and clothing details to you.

Thank you in advance.

https://photos.app.goo.gl/sjoqnY8gQyrVU3q58

Nice to meet you!
My name is Soreyuke Yumeko, a personal VTuber.
I saw Shiro Tsukise's illustration and contacted you because I would love to have you draw me, Yumeko.
If I meet your requirements, I would appreciate it very much...!

I would like to use it for the following purposes.
Use on SNS such as Twitter
For use on our YouTube channel.
Use within FANBOX, distribution of online prints and goods to FANBOX supporters
We would like to use it within the scope of Vtuber activities, such as commercial use in the sale of goods.
*It does not matter if commercial use is not allowed.
　If there is any use that is not allowed, we would appreciate it if you could inform us by using layers in the PSD data.

Request details
I would like you to draw an illustration of me, Yumeko, eating a donut!
https://x.com/______sr4/status/1737416160352862658
(This illustration is very cute...!)
I would like to use it as a thumbnail for a monetized YouTube video, so I would appreciate it if you could draw it in a larger size if at all possible.

Character Background
The character has a strong sense of humor, and loves to eat and take naps!
　She is a unicorn girl who fell from the sky!
She has stars in her eyes.
Her motifs are rainbows, clouds, stars, unicorns, and ribbons.

The motifs are rainbows, clouds, stars, unicorns, and ribbons.
We apologize for the inconvenience,
　We would greatly appreciate it if you could provide us with PSD data with the person, background, address, etc. separated into layers!

We would appreciate it if you could provide us with PSD data of the person, background, address, etc. in separate layers.

Vtuberの夢中染(ゆめなかそまる)と申します。拙い部分があると思いますが、ご了承のほどよろしくお願い致します。先日旅行の際きゃわいい共和国展を訪れさせて頂き月瀬しろ様の作品が好みで是非ご依頼したいと思いました。下記の内容をご確認の上，ご検討のほどよろしくお願い致します。【依頼内容】自分のVtuberを描いて頂きたいです。服装やポーズはお任せでお願いします。月瀬しろ様のペースでお描きして頂いて構いません。【使用用途】Vtuberの配信活動やTwitterでイラストを公開したりなどで使用します。（主にYouTubeでの利用となります）改めまして、よろしくお願い致します。 https://twitter.com/yumenaka_vjpn/status/1554775891083169792?s=21
